ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with low-intensity (dark) pixels dominating the central and medial regions (~65%) and high-intensity (white/light gray) pixels distributed across the distal lobe regions (~35%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity (white) zones localized on the distal thirds of both left and right lobes. Irregular low-intensity (black) mottling and focal spotting are embedded within these high-intensity distal zones, with higher spot density observed on the right distal lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with deep vertical penetration into the fluke body, dividing the lobes with approximately a 35-45 degree interior angle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile along the trailing boundary. Multiple sharp peaks and low-amplitude valleys (approx. 2-5 pixel depth) are visible, becoming more pronounced and 'ragged' at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the trailing edge of both lobes, tapering to narrow, pointed distal tips with a subtle posterior recurve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, high-contrast pixel clusters (white outer rings with dark centers) localized in the lower medial regions of both lobes, consistent with barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct, curved linear pixel disruption (rake-like mark) is visible on the lower inner quadrant of the right lobe, extending toward the peduncle.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Circular barnacle scarring present on both lobes; linear rake marks visible on the right lobe; right distal tip exhibits tattered, irregular edge topography indicating minor physical trauma.
